entities.name: Thunder Islands
entities.description: Islands in the Jamuraan Sea north of Shimia, home to savage berserkers.

entities.name: Lorens
entities.description: Thunder Islands native enslaved by Emperor Johan, later of the Circle of Seven; killed in the Battle of Efrava.

entities.name: Emperor Johan
entities.description: Enslaved Lorens to build floating airships.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Band Lorens joined after the slave rebellion.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader whose Circle of Seven included Lorens.

entities.name: Battle of Efrava
entities.description: Battle in which Lorens was killed.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War during which Lorens built airships.

events.summary: Emperor Johan of Tirras enslaves Lorens to build floating airships during Johan's War.
events.quote: was taken into slavery by Emperor Johan of Tirras

events.summary: After the slave rebellion Lorens joins the Robaran Mercenaries and becomes one of Adira Strongheart's Circle of Seven.
Lorens is killed in the Battle of Efrava, never seeing his home again.
events.quote: he was killed in the Battle of Efrava
